note: Monday weekly source suggestions — 3 vetted candidates, all confirmed accessible via WebSearch probe.

candidates.name: The Intercept
candidates.rationale: Fills an underrepresented hard-left beat with original reporting on AIPAC campaign finance, DSA primary mechanics, and Palestine-Israel policy intersections. Returns rich, dateable political content (Aug 1 articles confirmed). The current left roster lacks investigative depth on money-in-politics; Intercept would add it.

candidates.name: Just The News
candidates.rationale: Fills a right-center news hole with straight-news reporting (as opposed to opinion). Confirmed accessible with Aug 3 content on Blanche, Max Miller, Michigan primaries, government funding. Complements the existing right opinion-heavy roster with more factual-style coverage.

candidates.name: Reason
candidates.rationale: Adds a libertarian-leaning center voice not currently in the roster. Covers tariff economics, SCOTUS/executive power, and election reform from a civil-liberties-first lens that neither the existing left nor right sources provide. Confirmed accessible with Aug 2026 content.
